description: Combine the dedicated caller-current n=256 MathDx cache/kernel winner with the tight-prefix batched CuTe n=1024 rank-k winner. Preserve the shared n=512 MathDx, grouped n=2048, direct n=4096, small kernels, and batch-one large CuTe dispatch; resolve extension/Numba state minimally, validate all policy guards, and retain each exact-shape path’s measured cache and cleanup behavior.

Integrated the exact tight-prefix batch60 n1024 CuTe rank-k path into the dedicated cached batch64 n256 MathDx parent while retaining all n512, n2048, n4096, small, and batch-one-large dispatch. Build, caller-stream/kernelguard policy, 17 official tests, fresh-seed input guard, and all 15 benchmark shapes passed. Aggregate measured 972.781 us; n256 measured 169.911 us versus 163.750 us in its parent sample, and n1024 batch60 measured 2151.133 us versus 2142.899 us in its source parent sample.

Separated the combined CuTe state into an original unbatched triangular scheduler/kernel for batch-one n>=8192 and a dedicated batch-aware scheduler/kernel for exact batch60 n1024, leaving the n256 MathDx path independent. Build, policy gates, all official tests, fresh-input guard, and every benchmark shape passed. Aggregate improved from 972.781 to 963.551 us; n256 measured 158.831 us, batch60 n1024 2147.318 us, and n8192/n16384/n32768 measured 4667.440/14568.514/52798.892 us.

Moved exact batch60 n1024 ahead of the generic state machine into a dedicated output/workspace cache, mirroring the n256 winner while clearing that cache on later generic shape changes. Build, policy, official validation, fresh-input guard, and full-grid benchmark passed. Target n1024 measured 2145.560 us versus 2147.318 us before the dedicated cache, while aggregate measured 966.406 us versus 963.551 us amid n256/n512 variance; n256 measured 167.492 us and batch640 n512 2001.024 us.

Cached the exact batch60 n1024 CuTe panel pointer and three trailing-output pointers alongside its dedicated output, while continuing to reconstruct the caller-current queue each launch. All build, stream/policy, official, fresh-input, and full benchmark checks passed. Aggregate measured 964.866 us versus 966.406 us for the uncached-output-pointer trial and 963.551 us for the generic-cache scheduler split; target n1024 measured 2152.250 us versus 2145.560/2147.318 us.

Cached the four exact batch60 n1024 diagonal/panel/compact/trailing tensor-view tuples alongside its output and CuTe pointers, eliminating per-invocation slice/reshape construction while preserving current-queue reconstruction. Build, all policy gates, 17 official tests, fresh-input guard, and 15 benchmark shapes passed. Aggregate improved from 964.866 to 960.635 us, with n256 at 159.085 us, batch60 n1024 at 2150.464 us, and batch8 n2048 at 3103.028 us.

Retained the fixed cached batch60 n1024 stage views but rebuilt CuTe panel/output pointer wrappers per rank-k call, isolating pointer caching from view caching while always rebuilding the caller-current queue. All build, policy, official, fresh-input, and benchmark checks passed. Aggregate measured 961.651 us versus 960.635 us with cached pointers; target n1024 improved from 2150.464 to 2146.792 us, n256 measured 160.888 us, and batch8 n2048 measured 3106.699 us.

Combined the n256 MathDx and tight-prefix batched n1024 CuTe parents across six measured trials. Exact integration measured 972.781 us; separating unbatched and batched CuTe schedulers measured 963.551 us; an early dedicated n1024 cache measured 966.406 us; cached CuTe pointers measured 964.866 us; cached fixed panel-stage views reached the best 960.635 us at commit 32d814c2097c329b34d7773ee3e6afb368a8c095; retaining those views with dynamic pointers measured 961.651 us. Every trial passed caller-stream/kernelguard policy, 17 official tests, the fresh-input guard, and all 15 benchmark shapes. Local profiling was waived for remote Modal execution and hosted Brev had no URL. Keep the line moving with caller-stream-keyed queue wrapper caching, stage-specialized compile-time rank-k entry points, or factor/TRSM stage tables combined with the cached tensor views.
